 * WARG Platform — Game Data

 * Game object shape:
 * {
 *   id:            string       — unique slug

 *   emoji:         string       — fallback when no image URL
 *   image:         string|null  — URL to cover image
 *   progress:      number|null  — 0-100, null = not started
 *   progressLabel: string       — e.g. "3 / 5 waypoints"
 *   author:        { name, initials }
 *   likes:         number
 *   dislikes:      number
